critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/exams.py:131 — `mode` is a raw query string param accepted as `str` with no enum validation. mode='replace' and mode='append' work, but anything else (e.g. mode='wipe' or mode='') silently falls into the 'append' branch via the if/else. Recommend constraining: `mode: Literal['replace','append'] = 'replace'` so FastAPI rejects bad values with 422 instead of silently appending.

backend/services/ai_quiz_service.py:88 — every LLM exception is rewrapped as a 502 'AI generation failed — please retry'. This masks distinct failures (timeout vs rate-limit vs auth). Consider logging the original e.__class__.__name__ in the audit metadata so admins can see WHY the call failed without grepping logs.

backend/services/ai_quiz_service.py:128 — if every question is dropped (correct_answer not matching options) we raise 502, but the existing 'AI returned no valid questions' message doesn't tell the admin to retry with a smaller num. The current copy is fine, but worth confirming the frontend surfaces the 502 detail (it does as best-effort).

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/LeaderboardPage.tsx — cohort label includes member counts ('AGENT008 (4)'). Playwright `select_option(label='AGENT008')` therefore fails. This is correct UX (counts are useful) — flagging only as a testability note: consider exposing the raw cohort code in a `data-value` attribute or matching via option value rather than label in tests.

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ExamsPage.tsx — the AI quiz Save flow showed a success toast and closed the modal, but the body still contained 'saved/created' from the underlying exam list. Verified the new exam is in the list. Recommend an explicit data-testid on the success toast for robust e2e assertions.
